violations_csp_heuristique.text: Applying inline style violates the following Content Security Policy directive 'style-src 'self''. Either the 'unsafe-inline' keyword, a hash ('sha256-sp5LtZpsjkd478QV2m9DCYvMaYI3ANkcgXnFZ3y72kI='), or a nonce ('nonce-...') is required to enable inline execution. Note that hashes do not apply to event handlers, style attributes and javascript: navigations unless the 'unsafe-hashes' keyword is present. The policy is report-only, so the violation has been logged but no further action has been taken.
